####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To simulate the population above the serological threshold under different 
vaccination ages and a targeted delay during the bad season
####################################################################################################

# Set up

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../00_dirs.R")

theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Define main analyses

```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1",
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")
```

# Read in data

```{r}
# Obtain best models according to waic 
waic_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres/all_waicbest.rds"))
waiccomb_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waiccombbest.rds"))
waic_best_all <- bind_rows(waiccomb_best, waic_best)

waic_best_all %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(pat) %>% arrange(pat)

# Obtain inclusion/exclusion from simulations
all_datagapssim <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagapssim.rds"))

# Obtain model to variables 
tidy_modtovar <- readRDS(paste0(dirs$modres, "/tidy_modtovar.rds"))

# Threshold interpretation
threshold_ref <- read_excel(paste0(dirs$raw, "/thresholds_immvacc.xlsx"))
threshold_ref
```

# Obtain model information

```{r}
dat_mod <- waic_best_all %>%
  filter(dat != "sebirth_s08", mod_name_best != "base", str_detect(mod_best, "multi|opv", negate = TRUE), 
         dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08")) %>%
  left_join(tidy_modtovar %>% rename(mod_best = mod), by = join_by(pat, mod_out, dat, mod_best)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Prepare fixed covariates and thresholds

```{r}
# Obtain median for quantitative variables and unique values for qualitative variables 
dat_fixed <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat_mod)), function(x) {
  readRDS(paste0(dirs$modres, "/modres_ve/fixed_", dat_mod$mod_best[x]))
})

# Add dose interval variables when they are not part of the model
if (!"time_v1_v2" %in% names(dat_fixed)) dat_fixed <- mutate(dat_fixed, time_v1_v2 = NA)
if (!"time_v2_v3" %in% names(dat_fixed)) dat_fixed <- mutate(dat_fixed, time_v2_v3 = NA)

# Obtain methods and cutoffs for each model 
dat_cutoff <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(dat_mod)), function(x) {
  readRDS(glue("{dirs$modfit}/data", str_remove_all(dat_mod$dat[x], "_|s08"), "_brms_", 
               dat_mod$pat[x], "_v", dat_mod$vac[x], "_s08.rds")) %>%
    distinct(imm_met_s1, imm_sero_s1, threshold_assay = imm_cutoff_s1) %>%
    mutate(mod_best = dat_mod$mod_best[x], pat = dat_mod$pat[x])}) %>%
  left_join(threshold_ref, by = join_by(imm_met_s1, pat)) 

# Combine fixed values and thresholds   
dat_cov_all <- distinct(dat_fixed) %>% 
  mutate(
    age_fixed = if_else(age < 12, 8, 52),
    time_v1_v2_fixed = if_else(time_v1_v2 < 40, 30, 30),
    time_v2_v3_fixed = if_else(time_v2_v3 < 40, 30, 30),
    time_vl_s1_fixed = 30,
    time_v2_v3_fixed = if_else(pat == "rota", 60, time_v2_v3_fixed)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(dat_cutoff), by = join_by(mod_best, pat)) %>% 
  select(pat, mod_best, everything())
```

# Filter only selected pathogen, data, assay, and threshold 
```{r}
# Keep accepted thresholds and the same assay/model choices as VE
dat_cov <- dat_cov_all %>%
  filter(threshold_status == "accepted", pat %in% pat_sel, 
         !(str_detect(pat, "strep") & imm_met_s1 != "elisa"),
         !(pat == "strep04" & mod_best != "bmv3_s08_strep04_csi_reg_6.rds"))

# Check selected pathogen, data, assay, and threshold
select(dat_cov, pat, mod_best, imm_met_s1, threshold_protect, threshold_status, threshold_evidence)

saveRDS(dat_cov, glue("{dirs$modres}/modres_population/dat_cov.rds"))
```

# Estimate probability above threshold for a range of ages and all vaccination weeks 

# Range of ages 
```{r}
sim_vacage_young <- c(4:18)
sim_vacage_old <- c(26:78)
sim_ndraws <- 1000
```

```{r}
source("../fun_mod/fun_venewdata.R")
prob_threshold_files <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(dat_cov)), function(x) {
  # For each model 
  datmod_x <- filter(dat_mod, mod_best == dat_cov$mod_best[x]) %>% slice(1)
  
  # Define vaccination ages ========================================================================
  vacage_x <- if (dat_cov$age_fixed[x] == 8) sim_vacage_young else sim_vacage_old
  
  # Define paths (model_age_delay_draws)  ==========================================================
  path_prob <- as.character(glue(
    "{dirs$modres}/modres_population/prob_{str_remove(dat_cov$mod_best[x], '[.]rds$')}_",
    "age{min(vacage_x)}to{max(vacage_x)}_", "draw{sim_ndraws}.rds"))uy                                                 c
  path_mod <- file.path("/Volumes/ExternalSSD_LABG_Work/_seas_imm_backup/outputs/models",
                        datmod_x$pat[1], datmod_x$mod_best[1])
  path_dat <- paste0(dirs$modfit, "/data", str_remove_all(datmod_x$dat[1], "_|s08"), "_brms_", 
                     datmod_x$pat[1], "_v", datmod_x$vac[1], "_s08.rds")
  
  # Obtain probability =============================================================================
  prob <- pomp::bake(path_prob, dir = "", {
  message(glue("Estimating probability above threshold: {dat_cov$mod_best[x]}"))
    
    # Gather the data 
    mod <- readRDS(path_mod)
    dat <- readRDS(path_dat)
    datcov_x <- dat_cov[x, ]
      
    # Create new data for vaccination ages before and after the delay ------------------------------
    clu_name <- str_remove_all(datmod_x$mod_name_best[1], "csi_")
    age_pred <- c(vacage_x)
    
    # This new data has each individual times the different factors and for each age selected 
    newdat <- fun_venewdat(dat, datcov_x, clu_name) %>%
      filter(age == datcov_x$age_fixed[[1]]) %>%
      select(-age) %>%
      crossing(age = age_pred) %>%
      relocate(age, .after = sex)
    
    # Filter new data to keep just one vac_name_v1, doses, and only included clusters 
    if (datmod_x$pat[1] == "dipht" & "vac_name_v1" %in% names(newdat)) {
      newdat <- filter(newdat, vac_name_v1 != "dtpa") }
    if (str_detect(datmod_x$pat[1], "strep") &
        "vac_name_v1" %in% names(newdat)) {
      newdat <- filter(newdat, vac_name_v1 == "strep10") }
    if (datmod_x$pat[1] == "rota" & "doses" %in% names(newdat)) {
      newdat <- filter(newdat, doses != "3") }
    if (clu_name != "cs") {
      clu_included <- all_datagapssim %>%
        filter(mod == datmod_x$mod_best[1], included == TRUE) %>%
        pull(clu)
      newdat <- filter(newdat, str_remove_all(as.character(.data[[clu_name]]), " ") %in% clu_included) }
    
    # Obtain a sample of posterior draws
    draw_id <- sample(seq_len(ndraws(mod)), min(sim_ndraws, ndraws(mod)))
      
    # Obtain probability above from Gamma distribution ---------------------------------------------
    mu <- posterior_epred(mod, newdata = newdat, re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_id)
    shape <- as_draws_df(mod)$shape[draw_id]
    prob_mat <- pgamma(q = datcov_x$threshold_protect[[1]], shape = shape, rate = shape / mu, 
                       lower.tail = FALSE) %>% t()
    colnames(prob_mat) <- paste0("draw_", draw_id)
      
    # Keep posterior draws for the population simulation
    prob_draws <- newdat %>%
      bind_cols(as_tibble(prob_mat)) %>%
      pivot_longer(starts_with("draw_"), names_to = "draw", values_to = "prob") %>%
      mutate(draw = as.integer(str_remove(draw, "draw_")))
      
    # Add clu variable 
    if (clu_name != "cs") prob_draws <- rename(prob_draws, clu = all_of(clu_name))
    if (!"clu" %in% names(prob_draws)) prob_draws <- mutate(prob_draws, clu = NA)
    
    prob_draws %>%
      mutate(clu = str_replace_all(clu, " ", ""),
             mod_best = datmod_x$mod_best[1],
             pat = datmod_x$pat[1])
  })
  return(path_prob)
})
```
